text.p: Construction-based Lum Chang Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it expected to perform better in the current year.
In a note accompanying its 1996 full year results, Lum Chang said better contributions are expected from the property and hotels division in the current financial year.
It said if the stockbroking division continues to be profitable, it expects the group to perform better in the current year.
For the full year ended June 30 1996, the group posted a 47 percent increase in net profit to Singapore $20.42.
Lum Chang also said the divestment of its 35 percent interest in Solarvest Sdn Bhd when completed in January 1997 would result in an extraordinary gain of about S$18 million.
